doc.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Dave Kane, Bobby Avey's Vienna Dialogues and recent records
summary: They go through two Dave Kane dates and a classical-based duo with young pianist Bobby Avey as the discography nears its end.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Here’s with a piano player who was an old buddy of mine from Washington. That’s Dave Kane.
Yeah, his dates. You know him?
Yeah.
I don’t know him outside of the recordings.
We used to play together in Washington in the ’70s.
Very nice tunes. Good writing, very good writing.
Yeah, with Dave and Drew Gress and the late Mike Smith on drums. He was a wonderful drummer.
They’re the Washington contingent.
Mike died a couple of years ago of cancer, unfortunately.
Then we did another one. We did two with Dave. I did two with Dave.
Mike and Steve – Mike used to play with Steve Kuhn and Steve Slagle and the artist formerly known as Harvey Swartz.
Mike Smith?
Yeah.
Oh, our boy, Mr. Harvey S.
Yes, exactly. But he didn’t want to leave Washington.
We’ve getting close to the end. Here’s the one with Bobby Avey.
That’s the guy you just met.
He was here this afternoon. Vienna Dialogues.

Oh, that’s the duo. That’s the Chopin and Schubert. We took the old stuff, Chopin, Schubert, Bach, Debussy, Mahler Das Lied, boom boom boom. Bobby – I wanted to do something with Bobby, and I wanted to do classical. I gave him free rein to arrange it.
This is 2005.
We did that in the studio in (W)VIA, at the PBS studio up in Scranton.
He must have been about 9 years old at the time.
No, he was in his early 20s. But I’m going to give you his record of his stuff, which is phenomenal.
Here’s the second one with Dave Kane, Machinery of the Night. This is from 2006. We’re getting close to the end.
The end that you have.
Yeah, right, exactly.
Because I’ve got about ten more pages in the last year or two.
I’m sure you have.
I’m definitely over the top with this stuff.
